buySkip.buy: Buy the Callaway Elyte Driver if you are a mid-handicap golfer who wants a premium, forgiving driver with enough speed and adjustability to fine-tune launch and direction.
buySkip.skip: Skip it if you need the most draw-biased head, prefer a budget driver, or have not been fit well enough to know your loft and shaft window.

analysis: The Elyte Driver reads as a strong mid-handicap shortlist pick because it sits in the useful middle ground: premium speed technology, a 460cc footprint, adjustable loft options, and enough forgiveness for imperfect contact. Callaway positions the standard Elyte as a speed-and-forgiveness model rather than a niche low-spin tour head.

For many mid-handicap golfers, the fitting question matters more than the model name. The Elyte should be compared against more draw-biased, higher-launch, and maximum-forgiveness alternatives if the golfer fights a slice, launches too low, or loses too much ball speed across the face.
verdict: The Callaway Elyte Driver is a strong research-review pick for mid-handicap golfers who want a premium, balanced driver that emphasizes playable speed, forgiveness, and fitting flexibility.
